Barbie in the 12 Dancing Princesses.name: Barbie in the 12 Dancing Princesses
Barbie in the 12 Dancing Princesses.summary: Barbie in the 12 Dancing Princesses is the story of Barbie as Genevieve, 1 of 12 sisters who live happily with their father the king. Concerned that the high-spirited, independent princesses need more structure to become proper princesses, the king invites his cousin, the Dutchess Rowena to move into the castle. Rather than help, Rowina forbids the sisters from singing and dancing and squelches their individuality. The princesses discover a magical enchanted world and escape the tyranny of Rowena. But when Genevieve learns that their father's life is in danger, the sisters must unite to save the king and their kingdom.

Bibi & Tina - Jump & Ride.name: Bibi & Tina: Jump & Ride
Bibi & Tina - Jump & Ride.summary: 20 years of Martins Farm - reason enough for a huge party! But before we can finally start, Bibi and Tina have to look for old photos, solve tricky tasks and find many hidden ways.

Bleach DS 4th - Flame Bringer.name: Bleach DS 4th: Flame Bringer
Bleach DS 4th - Flame Bringer.summary: Flame Bringer is a platformer game similar to Bleach: Soul Carnival. The game features two-screen gameplay and nine playable characters.

Bubble Guppies.name: Bubble Guppies
Bubble Guppies.summary: Bubble Guppies is a DS game based on the pre-school TV show of the same name.

Chainz Galaxy.name: Chainz Galaxy
Chainz Galaxy.summary: Dive into 135 challenging levels and rattle the chains in 4 different game modes. Rack up your score with 8 exciting power-ups with enticing bonuses and 30 collectible charms. Link-matching madness just became even more challenging!

Chikyuu no Arukikata DS - Seoul, Busan '.name: Chikyuu no Arukikata DS: Seoul, Busan '07-'08

Diamond Trust of London.name: Diamond Trust of London
Diamond Trust of London.summary: A turn based strategy game funded via Kickstarter and released in 2012. Distribution was limited to Kickstarter backers and the website of the developer himself.

Freshly-Picked - Tingle's Rosy Rupeeland.name: Freshly-Picked Tingle's Rosy Rupeeland
Freshly-Picked - Tingle's Rosy Rupeeland.summary:
Freshly-Picked Tingle's Rosy Rupeeland is an adventure video game developed by Vanpool and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo DS handheld game console. It was first released in Japan, and was released in Europe on September 14, 2007, a year after its Japanese release.
Freshly-Picked Tingle's Rosy Rupeeland stars Tingle, a character who has appeared in several games in The Legend of Zelda series starting from The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask for the Nintendo 64. It was commercially successful in Japan, selling 234,862 units by the end of 2007.

Kyokugen Dasshutsu - 9-jikan, 9-nin, 9 n.name: Nine Hours, Nine Persons, Nine Doors
Kyokugen Dasshutsu - 9-jikan, 9-nin, 9 n.summary: The game is a murder mystery visual novel with a heavy story focus that requires multiple playthroughs to figure out and involves puzzle rooms used to progress through the story with dialogue choices to be made inbetween them.

Moetan DS.name: Moetan DS
Moetan DS.summary: A video game using design and cast from the TV series.

Monster Band.name: Monster Band
Monster Band.summary:
Do you want to travel the world? Do you want millions of people to know your name and to sing your songs? Do you want to become a pop star? Make your dreams come true! 
 
You are the leader of the hottest new band around. But, before you can make the charts you have to get creative. Compose your own music on 3 different instruments, learn to play famous songs and have tons of fun playing together with your friends. Make your wish come true – the stage is yours! 
 
Features: 
 
• Learn and play famous songs and styles 
• Play 3 different instruments and write your own songs (single or multi-player function) 
• Play solo mode, or join your friends for co-op or duel play

New International Track & Field.name: New International Track & Field
New International Track & Field.summary: The classic sporting game series of Track and Field celebrates its' 25th Anniversary by coming to the Nintendo DS. All the excitement and fun of the original titles is brought up to date with a bright and stylish new look, more events and online play.

Personal Fitness for Women.name: Personal Fitness for Women
Personal Fitness for Women.summary: A personal trainer for the Nintendo DS aimed towards women.

Pocoyo Racing.name: Pocoyo Racing
Pocoyo Racing.summary:
Pocoyo Racing is a child-oriented racing game with characters from the animation series Pocoyo.

The game follows the typical kart racing games mechanics like those of the Mario Kart series, where you race with different characters around a circuit and collect items with special effects in order to win the race.

Purr Pals.name: Purr Pals
Purr Pals.summary: Purr Pals is a pet simulation game in which the player takes care of a kitten. It is Crave Entertainment's answer to Nintendo's Nintendogs and is sponsored by Purina.

River City - Soccer Hooligans.name: River City Soccer Hooligans
River City - Soccer Hooligans.summary: Challenge the world's best soccer teams! Select your matches from 12 opposing teams from around the world. As Captain Kunio, you can strategize by changing your formations, checking weather forecasts, talking to your teammates, and giving them special items to boost their performance!
